title: Super Pikachu
description: Libre Pikachu and his ninja companions try to claim Pikachuland as his. Can the majesty of Super Pikachu’s unrelenting courage, along with the bravery of the townsfolk, save their home?
quote: We do have the will to protect our town together! It’s called the power of unity!
